name: Typewriter reveal
one_line: Text appears character by character at a steady cadence, as if typed, optionally with a cursor
summary: Characters arrive one after another at an even pace while the line grows in reading order, often with a cursor marking the point of entry. It reads as live, informal and deliberate, and suits a short line the viewer should follow as it is written. Long passages drag, and a cadence that falters reads as a fault rather than as typing.

routes.one_line: Text redrawn on a 2D canvas each frame, showing as many characters as the time allows

steps.does: Draw the visible slice of the string and the cursor as a function of t

limits: Text evidence is one loaded font; other fonts, kerning across the reveal edge and complex scripts are untested
No fixture reveals text by character; the proportional-width cursor position is not exercised
Canvas text is not selectable or editable, so any text alternative must come from elsewhere

routes.one_line: Per-character elements revealed on stepped timing with the Web Animations API

steps.does: Reveal each character element on its own stepped onset, and blink the cursor

limits: Its card avoids text splitting; the split into character elements is done outside it and is unevidenced
Evidence covers transform, stroke draw and staggered opacity; stepped easing is untested

source: references/typography §9c, references/motion-director §3.3; tool records as of 2026-11-20
